title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Red Apple Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Red Apple Ice Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a crisp, sweet fruit flavour with a cooling finish. Fresh Red Apple provides a juicy and slightly tangy base, while the icy exhale adds a clean chill for a refreshing all-day vape. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that keeps the pod automatically topped up. Together they provide up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no messy refills or coil changes required. Fitted with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures smooth vapour and consistent flavour throughout. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to go.
